name: Circular Saw
description: A handheld power saw with a toothed blade used for straight cuts in wood and other materials. It’s great for cross-cutting and ripping lumber on job sites.

name: Track Saw
description: Glides along a guide rail to make long, precise straight cuts. It’s ideal for sheet goods like plywood or MDF.

name: Reciprocating Saw
description: This saw uses a back-and-forth blade motion to cut through wood, metal, and even drywall. It’s a go-to tool for demolition work.

name: Jigsaw
description: Makes curved and intricate cuts in wood, plastic, and thin metals. It’s excellent for detailed or artistic cutting.

name: Drill
description: A basic yet essential tool used to bore holes and drive screws. It works on wood, metal, plastic, and masonry with the right bits.

name: Hammer Drill
description: This tool adds a pounding motion to the regular drilling action, allowing it to drill through concrete and brick. It's perfect for masonry work.

name: Impact Driver
description: Applies concussive rotational force, making it ideal for driving long screws and bolts. It’s stronger than a regular drill for fastening tasks.

name: Electric Screwdriver
description: This compact tool is used for quickly driving screws with minimal effort. It's useful for assembling furniture and light-duty work.

name: Impact Wrench
description: Used for loosening or tightening large bolts and nuts, especially in automotive and heavy machinery work. It delivers high torque output with minimal user effort.

name: Angle Grinder
description: A versatile tool with a spinning disc used for cutting, grinding, and polishing metal, tile, and concrete. It’s frequently used in metal fabrication.

name: Belt Sander
description: Quickly remove large amounts of material from wood or metal. They’re commonly used for leveling surfaces or stripping finishes.

name: Orbital Sander
description: These sanders move in random patterns to reduce swirl marks and leave a smooth finish. Great for preparing wood surfaces before painting or staining.

name: Rotary Tool
description: A compact, high-speed device that can grind, sand, polish, carve, or engrave. It’s widely used for precision tasks and hobbies.

name: Router
description: This tool hollows out areas in wood and shapes edges with various bits. Essential for cabinetry, joinery, and decorative trim work.

name: Band Saw
description: A stationary saw with a continuous blade loop for cutting curves, irregular shapes, and resawing thick wood. It’s popular in woodworking and metalworking.

name: Miter Saw
description: This saw makes precise crosscuts and angled cuts, especially useful for trim, framing, and molding. It pivots on a hinge and can be compound or sliding.

name: Table Saw
description: A powerful saw with a fixed circular blade protruding from a table surface. It’s central to most woodworking shops for rip cuts and repeated accuracy.

name: Wet Tile Saw
description: Designed for cutting ceramic and stone tiles with a water-cooled blade to reduce dust and heat. It’s vital in tiling and remodeling projects.

name: Bench Grinder
description: A stationary grinder with two rotating wheels used for sharpening tools or smoothing rough edges. Commonly found in metal and automotive shops.

name: Drill Press
description: A floor or bench-mounted drill that offers precise control over hole size and depth. It’s ideal for repetitive or exact drilling in metal or wood.

name: Lathe
description: Rotate workpieces on a horizontal axis while cutting tools shape the material. Used in woodturning and metalworking to create symmetrical objects.

name: Milling Machine
description: Use rotary cutters to remove material from metal or wood. It offers high precision in creating slots, holes, and complex shapes.

name: CNC Router
description: A computer-controlled router that automates intricate cutting, carving, and engraving tasks. Widely used in sign-making, cabinetry, and manufacturing.

name: Air Compressor
description: This machine stores compressed air to power pneumatic tools, inflate tires, and clean machinery. It’s a utility tool in garages and workshops.

name: Nail Gun
description: Drives nails into surfaces quickly and efficiently. It speeds up framing, roofing, and finish carpentry projects.

name: Chainsaw
description: Motorized saws with a rotating chain for cutting trees, branches, and logs. Available in gas or electric models.

name: Pole Saw
description: Essentially a small chainsaw on an extended pole, this tool trims hard-to-reach tree branches. It improves safety by eliminating the need for ladders.

name: Log Splitter
description: This hydraulic machine splits logs into firewood with ease. It saves time and physical effort compared to using an axe.

name: Hedge Trimmer
description: Uses reciprocating blades to trim shrubs and hedges neatly. It's available in corded, cordless, or gas-powered versions.

name: String Trimmer
description: Also known as a weed eater, this tool cuts grass and weeds in areas a lawn mower can’t reach. It uses a spinning nylon string for trimming.

name: Lawn Mower
description: Cuts grass evenly and is essential for lawn maintenance. Comes in push, self-propelled, and riding versions.

name: Leaf Blower
description: Directs air to clear leaves, debris, and grass clippings from yards or driveways. It reduces manual raking time.

name: Snow Blower
description: This tool removes snow from driveways and walkways by collecting and throwing it aside. It’s a winter essential in snowy regions.
